name: rc-local-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: adds a command line to /etc/rc.local (creating an executable one if absent -- on systemd Debian the static rc-local.service runs it at boot as soon as the file is executable). Idempotent via MARKER. Vars: RC_LINE (required), MARKER (optional distinctive substring used for the idempotency grep, default RC_LINE), PAYLOAD_PATH + PAYLOAD_BODY (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${RC_LINE:?RC_LINE is required}"

if [ -n "${PAYLOAD_PATH-}" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
    printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
fi

rc="/etc/rc.local"
marker=${MARKER:-$RC_LINE}
if [ ! -f "$rc" ]; then
    {
        printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh'
        printf '%s\n' "$RC_LINE"
        printf '%s\n' 'exit 0'
    } > "$rc"
elif ! grep -Fq -- "$marker" "$rc"; then
    tmp=$(mktemp)
    {
        grep -v '^[[:space:]]*exit 0[[:space:]]*$' "$rc" || :
        printf '%s\n' "$RC_LINE"
        printf '%s\n' 'exit 0'
    } > "$tmp"
    cat "$tmp" > "$rc"
    rm -f "$tmp"
fi
chmod 0755 "$rc"
